question: What purpose does this daṇḍaka composition serve in honoring the Goddess?
premises: This is a composition named daṇḍaka
It is offered to Śrī Devī
It is intended as an illumination or honoring
inference: This daṇḍaka composition shines forth as an act of illumination in honor of Śrī Devī.
plain_english: May this, named a daṇḍaka, shine forth as an illumination for Śrī Devī.
